title: South Beach Living High Protein Bar

content.title: About
content.content: South Beach Living High Protein Bar is a high‑protein snack bar designed to support an active lifestyle and weight management. Each bar provides about 20 g of protein, low sugar, and moderate carbs, making it a convenient post‑workout or on‑the‑go snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The bar combines whey and soy protein to deliver a complete amino acid profile.
Natural sweeteners such as stevia and erythritol are used, with no added sugar.
South Beach is a brand founded by dietitian Arthur Agatston, known for low‑carb nutrition programs.
The bar is gluten‑free and suitable for those with gluten intolerance.
Each bar comes in an individual wrapper, perfect for portability.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: Protein supports muscle recovery after exercise and helps maintain satiety.

items.title: Low sugar
items.content: Absence of added sugar aids in blood glucose control.

items.title: Source of fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and steady energy release.

items.title: Contains healthy fats
items.content: Nuts and seeds provide omega‑3 and omega‑6 fatty acids.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: The bar is fortified with B‑vitamins, vitamin E, and minerals such as magnesium and potassium.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: Whey protein may trigger reactions in individuals allergic to dairy.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Soy protein is present, so avoid if you have a soy allergy.

items.title: Calorie density
items.content: Despite low sugar, the bar contains roughly 200 kcal, so portion control is advised.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Erythritol and stevia can cause mild gastrointestinal discomfort in large amounts.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the bar as a standalone snack, blend it into smoothies, or chop it to top yogurt, oatmeal, or salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, consume within 7‑10 days.
